subject: PO formatting, net-terms & invoice rhythm — MedSys procurement asks
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medsys.io>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@medsys.io>, procurement@medsys.io
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO fields, net terms, and invoice cadence for annual commitment

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at MedSys is ready to move to a formal commitment but we need to align on a few billing/process items before our legal team proceeds:

- PO format: our AP requires the PO to include a Cost Center field and a GL code on the invoice line item. We can provide our PO template (attached).
- Net terms: MedSys standard is Net 45. Can Redwood accept Net 45 for annual SaaS commitments?
- Invoice cadence: our ERP reconciles best with a single monthly invoice per PO. We prefer monthly statements over weekly/biweekly runs. Is that possible?
- Discount/packaging: for an annual, committed seat/spend level (approx $480k ARR), procurement is targeting a 7% favourable discount plus waived onboarding fees.

Please confirm what Redwood needs on the PO and whether Net 45 + monthly invoicing and the discount target are feasible. If it helps, Rajiv (cc'ed) is leading the PO issuance and will attach the PO once we align.

Attached: MedSys_PO_Template_v3.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement, MedSys Health
elena.morales@medsys.io
Phone: +1 617-555-0126

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medsys.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 17:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields, net terms, and invoice cadence for annual commitment

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list and the template. Quick answers below and a few asks from our side:

- PO format: we can include a Cost Center and GL code on the invoice line. We will also add a PO number field and a dedicated "Redwood SKU/Subscription ID" for your ERP mapping. Please confirm the exact column header names you require (cost_center vs cost center, GL_code vs glcode).
- Net terms: our standard hosted API terms are Net 60, but we do make exceptions for strategic annual commitments. For a $480k ARR commitment we can move to Net 50 as a compromise.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoices are supported and preferred for reconciliation. We can emit one invoice per PO per month and include line-level PO and cost center metadata.
- Discount & packaging: we can offer a 6% committed-spend discount for the annual plan (and waive onboarding fees) if you sign a 12-month commitment with a quarterly usage true-up clause. For additional 1% (to reach 7%) we'd need either a 24-month commitment or a partial prepay.

I'll attach our short PO guidance for AP. Vanessa (billing) is cc'd to confirm invoice metadata and implementation. Grace is cc'd for finance approval gating. If this looks broadly OK, we can exchange a draft MA and route it for e-signature.

Attached: Redwood_PO_Guidance.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medsys.io>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@medsys.io>, procurement@medsys.io
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PO fields, net terms, and invoice cadence for annual commitment

Markus —

Thanks for the fast reply. A couple follow-ups from procurement and finance:

1) Column headers: please use exactly these headers for CSV import: "PO_Number", "Cost_Center", "GL_Code", "Invoice_Line_Desc", "Redwood_Subscription_ID". We can adapt if your system has hard constraints but we'd prefer to avoid manual re-keying into our ERP.
2) Net terms: MedSys policy requires Net 45 unless we get a pricing concession. We do not have budget to prepay for 24 months. If Redwood can approve Net 45, procurement is prepared to issue the PO this week.
3) Discount: procurement is firm on 7% for the committed volume; they have limited flexibility but will accept 6.5% if Net 45 is granted and onboarding fees are waived.

We can accept Net 50 only if there is a material concession on price (closer to 7%). Can you escalate internally for an exception to Net 60?

Also: please add a draft Master Agreement for review and a DocuSign link when ready.

Best,
Elena

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medsys.io>, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields, net terms, and invoice cadence for annual commitment

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the header list, that helps. To be explicit on execution and what AP will see on the invoice:

- We will populate the invoice CSV with the exact headers you listed: PO_Number, Cost_Center, GL_Code, Invoice_Line_Desc, Redwood_Subscription_ID. Our billing system will also include a human-readable description on the PDF invoice.
- Net terms: I spoke with finance — we can make an exception to Net 50 for this deal if MedSys accepts the 6% committed-spend discount and the quarterly true-up that Markus mentioned. Finance needs the Net 50 concession documented in the MA as a payment term amendment.
- Discount: we cannot comfortably give 7% at the $480k ARR level unless there is either (a) 24-month term or (b) 50% prepay on first invoice. 6% + waived onboarding + Net 50 is the internal stretch.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoices will be generated. First invoice would be generated on contract effective date and then monthly thereafter. We will ensure a line-level PO_Number and Cost_Center so your ERP can auto-post.

I've drafted a short MA with the payment amendment and attached it here. Once Marku(s) signs off, we'll send the DocuSign envelope to Elena and Rajiv.

Attachments: Draft_MA_for_MedSys.docx (Word)
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/abc123

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medsys.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@medsys.io>, procurement@medsys.io
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields, net terms, and invoice cadence for annual commitment

Vanessa / Markus —

Appreciate the flexibility and clarity. After a quick review with Rajiv and AP:

- MedSys can accept Net 50 as the compromise.
- We accept the 6% committed-spend discount and the quarterly true-up clause as documented.
- Monthly invoice cadence is fine — first invoice to be issued on contract effective date (we will set that to Jan 1, 2027 in the MA).
- Please proceed with the DocuSign envelope. We will route the MA through our legal and, assuming no redlines, procurement will issue the PO the same day the MA is executed.

Action items:
- Vanessa: please send the DocuSign link for signature and confirm the invoice CSV header mapping is implemented.
- Marku(s): please confirm final MA version and deal tag for HubSpot so we can align internal approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.

Elena Morales
Head of Procurement, MedSys Health
elena.morales@medsys.io
